summaries.name: Ford Mustang Shelby GT350R
summaries.summary: The user's current scale model project, as of 2023/05/27. The user is applying weathering effects (dirt, grime, rust, chipping, fading, tire wear) using Vallejo paints, which they are impressed with for color range and quality. For the wheels, recommended Vallejo Metal Color paints include Steel (77.721), Aluminum (77.722), Dark Aluminum (77.723), and Gunmetal (77.724), applied via layering, washes (Grey Wash 76.513, Brown Wash 76.514), drybrushing, and edge highlighting, finished with Vallejo Model Varnish (76.551) or Gloss Varnish (76.552) over a Metal Primer (77.601) base. The user plans to add realistic seatbelts using photo-etched metal strips and fabric, a detailed dashboard with gauges/switches/vents/trim, and a realistic engine and transmission with detailed components (engine block, cylinder heads, intake manifold, exhaust system, transmission case, gearbox, drivetrain).
